additional_info.subject: RE: ID0446153-DC/Si-D/NZ-[MP / P3 170000341]Lost comms with OCPP. CRM:02698000462
additional_info.body:
Hello Ingo,
Hope you are doing well.
Please see the logs from the router also attached in the case attachment section - "troubleshoot-router2-2025-08-21.tar"
As you have access to the router remotely, I believe you can also view this.
As additional information, the customer today has confirmed that they are able to get an IP and internet connection when connecting their laptop directly to the incoming cable for router XF4 (WAN side). This would confirm the customer's internet connection is operating as intended.
I have also remotely re-applied the router configuration (by setting it to Wired under SCB router configuration), and still we are unable to get an IP address.
It was noted during ticket ID0431614 the same issue was observed and expert services were able to reconfigure the router, but it appears this may be a re-occuring issue.
Could you please provide us with guidance on if this issue can be addressed remotely or whether we should go ahead and replace the XF4 router, as this one is suspected to be defective?
Thanks Ingo, talk soon.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
